finalText:
Found it. `processOrder.js` grabbed a connection but only released it after a successful run — no `try/finally`. Every rejected order (like the bad payloads worker-1 kept hitting after 2:06am) leaked one connection permanently. Five leaks later the pool was empty, requests started timing out, and the supervisor restarted things around 2:11–2:13.

Wrapped it in `try/finally` so the connection releases either way. All 4 tests pass now.
